preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 200000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 200000.
The lengths of strings s and t must match the given n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s must consist of lowercase Latin letters and at most one wildcard character '*.'

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(s[:i] + t[i:i+len(s)-i-1] + s[i+1:] == t for i in range(n+1)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a valid replacement of the wildcard character '*' in s to match t, otherwise output 'NO'.
